card: This PR updates the `src/crc32c` subtree to include upstream PR #10, which converts header constants to `inline constexpr`. This change avoids unused constant variable warnings when headers are included across translation units. Merging this unblocks PR #36275 to enable `-Wunused-const-variable` in the build system.
changed_since_previous: No substantive changes; the commit tree and patch are now recorded.
evidence: PR description links to crc32c-subtree PR #10 ('refactor: use inline constexpr in headers') and states it is 'Used in #36275'
problem: Constants defined in crc32c header files without `inline` can trigger unused variable compiler warnings when included in translation units that do not reference them, preventing the build system from turning on `-Wunused-const-variable`.

risk.why: A mistake in subtree header constants could break compilation on certain compilers or cause faulty checksum calculations.

summary: Updates the `src/crc32c` subtree to commit 60bcf13edf, importing a refactor that marks constants in header files as `inline constexpr`.
